title: LaPaz studies green fireballs following nuclear debris
place_text: University of New Mexico; United States

tellings.quote: in 1948 49 he was basically studying green Fireballs following the plume radioactive debris post nuclear blasts across the US

plain: In 1948 and 1949, the University of New Mexico scientist Lincoln LaPaz was studying "green fireballs", bright green lights in the sky, and finding that they followed the plumes of radioactive debris left by nuclear blasts across the US. Michels tells this himself, naming Dan Wilson and Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who studied UFO reports, as people tied to the story. If true, it would link the lights to America's nuclear activity.
